description: Cities’ Investment in Road Infrastructure Systems across Regions Version 3 is a data set deposited in ICPSR by its authors Agustin Leon-Moreta, Omowonuola Fayemiro (University of New Mexico). The data described here were used in the analysis and findings reported in the article, Leon-Moreta, A., Fayemiro, O., & Esquivel, A. (2025). Cities’ investment in road infrastructure systems across regions. Regional Studies, Regional Science , 12 (1), 185–204. https://doi.org/10.1080/21681376.2025.2464669 . A STATA (V. 13) do-file for calculating variables is also included. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The repository holds 2 deposits of this kind (versions, parts or per-site or per-year releases); this record describes the series through its most recent member and lists the others in the notes. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and ICPSR normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-icpsr-repository.
